chunks: 1592 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

While the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was in the mosque, he said, “Stand up, O so-and-so; stand up, O so-and-so; stand up, O so-and-so,” until he had brought out five persons. Then he said, “Leave our mosque; do not perform salat (prayer) in it while you do not pay zakat (alms-tax).”

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.ٱلْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, the communal place of worship

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about those who refuse to pay zakat and pray in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله publicly removed several people from the mosque because they were refusing to pay zakat. It underscores the grave seriousness of withholding zakat and shows that neglecting this obligation affects one’s standing in the worshipping community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1592 - Ibn Muskan reported from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:

"While the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, was in the mosque, he said, 'Stand up, so-and-so, stand up, so-and-so, stand up, so-and-so,' until he had removed five individuals. Then he said, 'Leave our mosque. Do not pray in it while you do not pay Zakat.'"
